script.base: Book expects PHI to lead a moderate outdoor game, implied 25.2-18.2. Eagles are ahead by halftime or late. Without A.J. Brown they still have to throw to get to 25, with DeVonta Smith (26 targets, 346 yards in weeks 5-7) and Dallas Goedert (23 targets, 147 yards) as the pass options and Saquon Barkley (36 carries, 132 rush yards) taking late clock. NYG, a 7-point dog that has been run-heavy (Cam Skattebo 50 carries, Jaxson Dart 22 rushes in those three weeks), falls behind and is pushed toward more throws to Wan'Dale Robinson (26 targets, 209 yards) and Theo Johnson (18 targets, 126 yards).
script.flip1: PHI jumps up big early, leans on Barkley against NYG's 5.49 YPC run defense, and Hurts' pass volume stalls after the lead, so Smith and Goedert unders hit while NYG abandons the run and Robinson/Johnson targets spike (Skattebo rush line dies).
script.flip2: NYG stays close or leads behind Dart's legs (126 rush yards in weeks 5-7) and Skattebo, so PHI cannot clock-kill, Smith stays in a pass-heavy script all day, and Barkley's carry projection dies. A weather slog is the other flip, but no forecast was saved.

PHI CB Adoree' Jackson Out (concussion) and CB Jakorian Bennett Out (pectoral) leave unnamed backups on Robinson. NYG K Graham Gano Questionable is irrelevant to these markets. pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost. PHI led big by half, Hurts handed Barkley the ball against a defense allowing 5.49 YPC, and Smith finished in the 40s because Goedert and Dotson took the quick-game and red-zone looks once Jurgens was off the field, the same split as his 49-yard game. Robinson lost because Nabers, missing from weeks 5-7 but not listed out, played and took the WR1 share, and NYG kept the Skattebo/Dart run game (50 and 22 rushes) instead of becoming a dropback team, so Robinson repeated the 30. A second loss path: 53.5 and 55.5 are season-median stand-ins, and a real book may already have moved Smith well past 53.5 after the Brown news, so there was never a price. Unsaved weather could also have sat on the intermediate throws that produced the 183 and the 95.
